visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a steaming bowl of vegetable and tofu egg soup. A hand reaches in to place fresh cilantro on top. The background is a brightly lit kitchen. (2) The scene shifts to an orange pot on an induction stove. Water is poured in from a kettle. (3) Dashi bags are added to the water, followed by a pinch of salt and liquid seasonings poured from a small white bowl. (4) A piece of dried kombu is cut with scissors and dropped into the pot. (5) The pot is covered with a lid. The scene cuts to a close-up of fresh red tomatoes being sliced into eighths on a yellow cutting board. (6) Garlic is finely minced with a chef's knife. Silken tofu is carefully cubed and transferred into a bowl of water using a spatula. (7) Enoki mushrooms have their ends trimmed and are then rinsed in a stainless steel bowl of water before being drained. (8) The dashi bags and kombu are removed from the pot. Olive oil is poured into a white pan, followed by the minced garlic. (9) The garlic is sautéed with a wooden spoon, and sliced tomatoes are added and seasoned with salt and pepper. (10) The prepared dashi broth is poured into the pan with the tomatoes. Tofu cubes, cherry tomatoes, and enoki mushrooms are added sequentially as the liquid simmers. (11) A woman's hands crack eggs into a bowl and whisk them. The egg wash is then drizzled in a circular motion into the boiling soup. (12) Fresh green vegetables are chopped and added to the pot. (13) The woman is shown from the chest up, wearing an apron, tasting the soup with a spoon and smiling happily at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 超級簡單，超好喝的『青菜豆腐蛋花湯』每天～❤️❤️. (2) [Subtitle]: 加入1200~1300ml冷水. (3) [Subtitle]: 無調味的昆布柴魚高湯包兩包. (4) [Subtitle]: 放進來.... (5) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽. (6) [Subtitle]: 10ml醬油、15ml味醂、15ml清酒. (7) [Subtitle]: 有的話，加一條昆布進來煮.... (8) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮滾.... (9) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後，轉小火蓋上鍋蓋煮10~12分鐘. (10) [Logo]: Le Creuset. (11) [Subtitle]: 可以準備這種『黑柿番茄』帶有番茄的酸味～. (12) [Subtitle]: 去掉蒂. (13) [Subtitle]: 切成八等份. (14) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭剁成蒜末.... (15) [Subtitle]: 嫩豆腐一份，切成方塊. (16) [Subtitle]: 把豆腐先放到水裡避免破掉.... (17) [Subtitle]: 金針菇切掉蒂用手撕一撕.... (18) [Subtitle]: 蒂的地方沖洗一下木屑. (19) [Subtitle]: 換盆水，再洗一次. (20) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分，把水分擠乾一旁晾乾.... (21) [Subtitle]: 好囉～高湯煮好了！. (22) [Subtitle]: 超簡單的高湯就煮好了..... (23) [Subtitle]: 撈出高湯包.... (24) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入適量橄欖油開中火加熱..... (25) [Subtitle]: 稍微爆香一下..... (26) [Subtitle]: 聞到蒜香，就可以把番茄放進來了. (27) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽、綜合胡椒調味..... (28) [Subtitle]: 稍微拌炒一下.... 炒到這樣就可以了.... (29) [Subtitle]: 加入剛剛的高湯進來.... (30) [Subtitle]: 把湯煮滾.... (31) [Subtitle]: 豆腐瀝掉水分放到湯裡..... (32) [Subtitle]: 接著放入15顆左右的小番茄增加湯的甜味～. (33) [Subtitle]: 放入金針菇... 建議切成三等長，會比較好入口. (34) [Subtitle]: 把火轉到最小，慢慢的把豆腐煮透.... (35) [Subtitle]: 一旁打2~3顆蛋.... (36) [Subtitle]: 打成蛋液.... (37) [Subtitle]: 切一些青菜.... (38) [Subtitle]: 煮到豆腐浮起來小番茄爆開.... (39) [Subtitle]: 試喝一下，做鹹味調整. (40) [Subtitle]: 放入青菜梗. (41) [Subtitle]: 淋上蛋液.... (42) [Subtitle]: 等蛋凝固之後再翻動.... (43) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，就可以關火囉～. (44) [Subtitle]: 最後再放入青菜葉. (45) [Subtitle]: 喜歡香菜的朋友來一點香菜... ❤️❤️. (46) [Subtitle]: 哇～香噴噴的嫩嫩的豆腐，好吃❤️❤️. (47) [Subtitle]: 湯酸酸甜甜的超好喝～❤️❤️ 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a gentle, melodic piano track in a major key. A female voice with a friendly and clear tone introduces the dish. (2) A clear SFX of water being poured into a pot occurs, followed by the sound of dashi bags rustling as they are placed into the water. (3) The rhythmic, percussive sound of a chef's knife slicing through fresh tomatoes and mincing garlic is heard. The narrator continues her step-by-step guidance. (4) A metallic click is heard from the induction cooker. Then, a distinct sizzling sound of garlic hitting hot olive oil in a pan dominates the mix momentarily. (5) As the broth is added, there is a splashing sound. The background music remains consistent, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere. (6) The sound of eggs being whisked in a bowl—a fast, scraping rhythmic sound—is followed by the soft bubbling of the soup. (7) Towards the end, the sound of the woman slurping the soup and then exclaiming 'Mmm!' with high positive valence and rising intonation is clearly audible, conveying satisfaction.
